visual.detailed_description: Black tracing on a pink grid of a 12-lead electrocardiogram in three rows of four lead columns plus three long rhythm strips at the bottom. A white box with the numeral "1" sits at the top left. Small printed lead labels read I, aVR, V1, V4 (first row), II, aVL, V2, V5 (second row), III, aVF, V3, V6 (third row), and V1, II and V5 for the three lower rhythm strips. A square calibration pulse starts each row. Complexes in each strip are narrow and spaced at fairly even intervals, each followed by a small rounded deflection; the leads differ in the direction and height of the complexes, with the chest leads V2 and V3 showing the tallest and deepest complexes. No patient name, identification number, date, time, rate or interpretation text is legible; paper speed and gain labels are not printed.
